name: iac-scan
description: Scan the Terraform, CloudFormation, Kubernetes and CI configuration a repository actually contains, decide what each finding means in this environment, and land the result in Noru as security findings — closing the ones that no longer reproduce.

interface.shortDescription: Turn infrastructure misconfiguration into reviewed security findings.
interface.longDescription: Asks Noru which findings this piece already has open, reads the Terraform, CloudFormation, Kubernetes and pipeline configuration in the repository, and proposes a finding for each rule that fires with a citation instead of a copy of the line. A person decides whether each one is real here, how bad it is here and until when that stands; the result lands as security findings through an upsert keyed on source and external id, and the findings that no longer reproduce are closed by the same call.
capabilities: Terraform, CloudFormation, Kubernetes and pipeline configuration
Findings keyed on the resource, not on the line number
Citations rather than copies of what matched
Closes findings whose rule no longer fires
interface.defaultPrompt: Scan my infrastructure configuration and show me what changed since the last scan.
